candidates.title: Daily sales by product
candidates.why_relevant: Daily grain sales data (units_sold, revenue_eur) by product_code covering 2022-01-01 to present. Directly serves N1 for both windows.
suspected_issues: Gap 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10 due to till replacement (wiki: till_migration_2024)
Product codes changed 2024-04-01 (codes ending in L replaced)
No mapping table exists for old to new product codes (wiki: product_codes_2024)

candidates.title: Product list (current codes)
candidates.why_relevant: Current product codes with names and categories (64 products). Helps decode product_code in sales and could partially help N2 via product name matching.
suspected_issues: Lists only current (post-2024) codes, not historical ones
Some product names are not unique - matching by name may be unreliable (wiki: product_codes_2024)

candidates.title: Shop calendar (opening days, closures, local events)
candidates.why_relevant: Daily calendar with is_open (boolean) and event_name (local events). Directly serves N5 for both windows. Covers 2022-01-01 to present.
suspected_issues: No wiki backlinks found - documentation status unknown
Event descriptions may not cover all local events that affect foot traffic
Does not capture reduced hours vs fully open distinction

candidates.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API
candidates.why_relevant: Public API for historical daily temperature data. Can request daily maximum temperature for any coordinates. Registered for UC2, approved for prototyping and production.
suspected_issues: Coordinates not confirmed - Milan (45.4642, 9.1900) is plausible but assumed
Data lag may mean most recent days unavailable
ERA5 grid cell may not match local microclimate

candidates.title: Nager.Date public holidays API
candidates.why_relevant: Public API for Italian national public holidays. Returns date and name per holiday. Registered for UC2, approved for prototyping and production. MIT-licensed.
suspected_issues: Only covers national holidays - regional/local holidays not included
Check API convention for holidays falling on weekends
May not match shop definition of holiday

searches_run: search_internal_catalog(old new product codes ice cream)
search_internal_catalog(product name mapping old codes 2023 2024 gelato)
unmet_needs: N2 (Product code mapping): The wiki page product_codes_2024 explicitly states: No mapping table exists between old and new codes. Codes changed 2024-04-01 (codes ending in L replaced). Matching can only be done by product name, but some names are not unique. No internal or register source provides a mapping. Critical gap.

N4 (Public holidays - regional/local): Nager.Date only covers national holidays. No internal or register source found for regional/local Italian holidays. The store.calendar event_name may partially cover this but not systematically.
N5 (Local events completeness): store.calendar has event_name but no wiki documentation on coverage methodology. Events from 2023 may be less complete than recent ones.
